title: Reconcile rental funding and approve the reserve policy
source: Plan: Startup Funding Before Lease Up, Reserve Before Income; Budget: Rental!C4:C9,E10:E19
checklist: Confirm whether the $9,000 or $18,000 reserve governs
Reconcile $22,310 plan funding against $20,000 workbook funding
Decide whether the $2,000 preparation cushion remains additive; current C6 formula consumes it
Approve one written funding/distribution policy and record assumptions
Update a working budget copy after approval, preserving the supplied original

title: Confirm actual RSU proceeds and household emergency funding
checklist: Replace the $96,290 proceeds estimate with actual net proceeds or document why unavailable
Confirm taxes, withholding and any adviser follow-up without assuming the estimate is spendable cash
Check rental, BandyWorks and property equipment allocations against available cash
Validate the $26,000 emergency reference against household needs
Record any funding shortfall before commitments

title: Obtain and verify the signed sale-listing release
source: Plan appendix Task 1; Existing Listing Agreement
checklist: Prepare release terms for Amanda Anderson and Realty Executives Hometown Living
Resolve cancellation costs, prior-buyer protection, active prospects and surviving commissions or rental rights
Obtain complete owner and broker signatures
Confirm MLS/public advertising removal, showings cancellation and sign/lockbox return
Retain executed release and written confirmations

title: Obtain landlord insurance and written closed-pool requirements
checklist: Obtain a written quote with effective dates, vacancy coverage, dwelling, liability, loss of rent and deductibles
Confirm water backup, service lines, ordinance coverage and umbrella needs
Obtain written cover, fence, gate, signs, inspections and maintenance requirements for the closed pool
Request pool-vendor scope and quote
Save quote and requirements; do not treat an unbound quote as active coverage

title: Compare management proposals and choose an operating model
source: Plan appendix Task 4; Two Management Paths
checklist: Request two proposals including management, placement, renewal, inspection, vendor markup and cancellation fees
Confirm responsibility for screenings, emergencies, deposits, notices, records and tenant benefits
Compare actual fees with the 9% model
Record manager selection or deliberate owner-management decision
Assign primary and backup owners; document six-month avoided-fee retention if self-managed

title: Collect closing records and create the improvement schedule
checklist: Collect closing statement, invoices, permits, contracts, payments and photos
Document garage conversion, added area and exterior work
List each project, completion date, contractor, amount and evidence location
Flag missing evidence and repairs-versus-improvements questions for the adviser

title: Confirm lender requirements and update insurance and escrow costs
source: Plan appendix Task 2; Risks, Assumptions, and Unfinished Work
checklist: Confirm lender/servicer rental-conversion requirements and evidence-of-coverage delivery
Verify insurance effective date and any escrow/payment change
Replace the incremental $125 insurance estimate with actual incremental cost
Record written instructions and avoid double-counting insurance already in escrow

title: Establish property accounts and fund the approved reserve
checklist: Owners establish dedicated operating/reserve and separate insured tenant-deposit accounts
Fund the approved reserve before lease signing or document the approved ramp plan
Keep the tenant deposit outside business cash and benefit funding
Retain funding evidence without putting bank identifiers in GitHub

title: Define mower, woods vehicle and trailer requirements
source: Property Equipment!A9:F14; requirements inferred from unquoted categories
checklist: Document terrain, mowing area, intended loads and storage
Confirm tow-vehicle capacity, hitch, payload and trailer needs
List safety gear, accessories and maintenance supplies
Set category priorities within the combined $20,000 allowance

title: Inspect safety, mechanical systems, grounds and septic
source: Plan appendix Task 6; startup inspection estimate $1,500
checklist: Schedule inspections covering alarms, locks, windows, stairs/rails, electrical, plumbing, water heater, HVAC and appliances
Review septic, pests, drainage, trees and trip hazards
Classify findings as required before marketing, required before occupancy, preventive or cosmetic
Obtain itemized quotes and update the startup cost register

title: Confirm Phase 0 scope and delivered-cost quotes
checklist: Confirm laser, saw/stand, drill press and design-dependent wet-saw models
Obtain current tax, freight, accessory, installation and warranty costs
Retain the existing K1 Max; exclude UV laser/CNC and superseded $27,000 plan
Reconcile $8,930.42 listed subtotal and $3,069.58 buffer with $12,000 ceiling
Price any separate operating reserve

title: Configure bookkeeping, reserve categories and payment transitions
checklist: Create ledger for rent, mortgage, insurance, repairs, vacancy, capital, turnover, pool, benefits and distributions
Establish receipt storage and monthly reconciliation
Configure reserve percentages and $75 benefit funding after approved budget check
Verify first due dates and overlap before moving autopay
Track known 90-day costs and distribution stop conditions

title: Configure rental platform, emergency coverage and vendor roster
source: Plan: What Self Management Requires; appendix Task 4
checklist: Select platform for applications, screening, signatures, rent, maintenance and records
Establish primary and backup contact and a 24-hour emergency method
Confirm plumber, HVAC, electrician, locksmith, pool and general-repair contacts
Define repair approval, entry, late-payment, inspection, renewal and deposit workflows
Test intake and emergency routing; keep tenant records outside GitHub

title: Approve screening criteria and base lease terms
checklist: Document consistent income, credit, rental history, occupancy, pets, identity and background criteria
Define incomplete-application treatment and application order
Set rent, floor, deposit, lease length, due date, utilities, insurance and other business terms
Draft lawn duties and closed-pool clauses
Obtain professional review before accepting applications

title: Validate workshop layout, electrical work and fire protection
source: BandyWorks!A14:H17,A42:H43; implementation task inferred from purchase dependencies
checklist: Map laser, clean assembly, wood-dust and wet-stone work areas
Verify benches, carts, storage and equipment clearances
Obtain electrician quote for load, circuits and lighting
Define required fire/safety equipment and installation scope
Document constraints before ordering machinery

title: Validate and document Fair Partnership benefits
source: Plan: Fair Partnership Credit and Capital Program; appendix Task 7
checklist: Confirm platform, bureau coverage, fees, consent, privacy and dispute process
Define objective quarterly eligibility and prospective $75 credits
Define $400 annual benefit and owner-funded 3% deposit-growth bonus
Check actual deposit and fees against $900 yearly funding; $3,595 deposit with $104 reporting yields $911.85 modeled maximum
Obtain legal/tax review and document no ownership interest or deposit-funded benefits
Assign monthly, quarterly and annual administration

title: Quote optional services and approve the service addendum
source: Plan: Optional Lease Services; appendix Task 7
checklist: Obtain dependable quotes for optional lawn, trash, cleaning and any selected additional services
Confirm cost-plus 10%–15% pricing and access/schedule terms
Define cancellation, missed visits and renewal pricing
Document landlord responsibility for hazardous trees, drainage and major exterior work
Omit unquoted options and keep pool access excluded

title: Verify laser exhaust and wood-dust collection compatibility
checklist: Verify xTool airflow requirements and proposed S6 fan compatibility
Confirm metal duct route, termination, damper, mounting and installed cost
Validate saw capture, separator, hoses and whole-system filtration
Do not treat a filter upgrade alone as proof of certified HEPA extraction
Obtain documented suitable equipment/installation plan

title: Validate wet-stone prototype equipment and containment
checklist: Confirm candidate wet saw and polisher suitability for intended stone work
Determine whether the reservoir eliminates a separate recirculation pump
Specify splash tray, wet-zone mat, lidded settling buckets, filtration and slurry handling
Verify electrical/wet-area safety with a qualified professional
Obtain quotes before buying design-dependent equipment

title: Complete insurer-required pool closure and winterization
checklist: Approve vendor scope consistent with the insurer's written conditions
Complete cover, fence/gate, equipment shutdown and winterization work
Define owner/vendor periodic checks
Save dated photos, invoices and completion confirmation
Keep pool access unavailable

title: Obtain delivered-cost equipment quotes and compare options
checklist: Quote mower, woods vehicle, small box trailer and necessary accessories
Include taxes, delivery, setup, safety/storage and initial maintenance
Verify compatibility and inspection/warranty needs
Record costs in a working budget and distinguish unquoted from zero
Present an option set within $20,000 or document a funding decision

title: Confirm rental tax setup and the future sale decision window
source: Plan: Tax Treatment and Implementation; appendix Task 5
checklist: Have the tax adviser determine conversion basis, building/land allocation, valuation evidence and rental start date
Record actual residence dates and adviser-confirmed sale/renewal decision deadlines
Review depreciation, reporting and owner-funded tenant bonus treatment
Create dated follow-up issues once adviser deadlines are known

title: Complete required repairs and make-ready cleanup
source: Plan appendix Task 6; repairs $2,500, cleanup $1,150 estimates
checklist: Approve prioritized quotes against available startup funding
Complete safety/habitability work and required repairs
Finish deep cleaning, touch-ups, lawn stabilization and exterior cleanup
Reinspect work and retain invoices
Record any deferred cosmetic work and occupancy blockers explicitly

title: Finalize reviewed lease, addenda and move-in packet
checklist: Have Tennessee counsel or qualified property manager review lease, notices and deposit procedure
Finalize optional-service and Fair Partnership addenda
Configure approved forms, signatures, rent and maintenance functions
Prepare condition report, key log, emergency instructions and acknowledgments
Store reviewed versions and completion evidence

title: Approve readiness and publish the rental listing
source: Plan appendix Task 8; prerequisite schedule synthesized from Tasks 1–7
checklist: Confirm executed release, active appropriate coverage, lender confirmation, safety, reserve and lease readiness
Resolve all marketing/occupancy blockers or postpone launch
Owners approve publication at $3,595
Publish through selected platform and broad rental channels
Record actual listing date and rebase day-7/day-14 review dates

title: Reconcile quotes, actual spend and remaining project funding
checklist: Update working budget with actual receipts and firm quotes across all workstreams
Keep rental recurring reserves separate from startup costs
Recompute emergency residual and retain unallocated BandyWorks/property funding correctly
Flag remaining unpriced installation, insurance, repairs and operating reserve
Record funding decisions and repeat weekly through initial procurement

title: Prepare professional photos, floor plan and listing copy
checklist: Capture accurate photos and a floor plan if available
Describe area, bedrooms, acreage and property limitations accurately
Disclose closed pool, tenant lawn duties, insurance and complete base terms
Include optional services only when quoted and documented
Review publication channels and application process

title: Approve and procure the Phase 0 package within funded limits
checklist: Owners approve final installed-cost bill of materials and any operating reserve
Prioritize required machinery, furniture, infrastructure and safety scope
Include printer filament/maintenance, prototype supplies and software only as needed
Record orders, delivered costs and delivery dates
Recheck emergency cash if total funding exceeds $12,000; do not infer purchase authorization from this issue

title: Approve and acquire the property equipment package
checklist: Owners approve exact items and combined funding
Complete any required inspections and documentation before purchase
Record purchases, delivery timing and receipts
Reconcile actuals against the allowance and emergency residual
Do not infer transaction authorization from the planning issue

title: Track qualified inquiries, showings and applications
checklist: Maintain a private log of qualified inquiries, showings and complete applications
Use move date, household size, approximate income, pets and acceptance of terms to qualify inquiry interest
Respond promptly and document price feedback
Track local comparison activity and listing reach
Report aggregate activity without applicant personal data
event: Start at actual listing publication; continue daily until leased or paused

title: Review the first seven days of rental demand
source: Plan: How and When to Change the Asking Rent; appendix Task 8
checklist: Review qualified interest and completed applications
Check photos, terms, distribution, response time and application friction
Compare local listings and record feedback
Do not cut price solely because the home remains unleased
event: Actual listing date + 7 days; November 13 is only a placeholder

title: Install and verify workshop systems before production
source: BandyWorks purchase dependencies; proposed implementation sequence
checklist: Complete approved electrical, exhaust, collection and containment installation
Assemble benches/carts/storage and inspect delivered machinery
Follow manufacturer setup and safety instructions with professional support where required
Record functional checks and unresolved defects before use
Preserve manuals, receipts, warranties and maintenance requirements

title: Inspect deliveries and establish equipment upkeep
checklist: Inspect delivered items and document defects
Verify towing/load compatibility, storage and safety equipment
Retain manuals and train intended operators
Record manufacturer service intervals and recurring maintenance dates
Assign an equipment owner

title: Evaluate completed applications under approved criteria
checklist: Process applications in disclosed order with consistent criteria
Verify required identity, income, employment, credit, background and rental history
Owners or qualified manager document decisions and required notices
Keep screening evidence in the rental system
If no acceptable applicant exists, leave blocked and revise target rather than lowering standards
event: When a complete application arrives; November 20 is a review target, not promised placement

title: Make the day-14 asking-rent decision
checklist: Review complete applications and qualified price feedback
Move from $3,595 to $3,195 only if source criteria are met
Otherwise document holding, leasing or pausing
Record actual fallback date if changed and schedule a review at least seven days later
event: Actual listing date + 14 days; stop price-test tasks once leased

title: Run prototype trials and establish repeatable costs
checklist: Test selected stone, acrylic, wood/brass and packaging concepts using suitable processes
Confirm material/adhesive/finish compatibility
Use outsourcing for specialty work as needed within funded scope
Record material usage, labor, scrap and results
Activate only needed software licenses and record renewals
Decide which products/processes merit a later launch plan; commercial launch scope is not supplied

title: Execute lease and complete pre-possession requirements
checklist: Confirm rent, dates, occupants, pets, utilities, insurance, lawn, pool and selected services/benefits
Owners execute all lease documents and collect cleared initial rent/deposit into correct accounts
Verify insurance evidence, utility transfer and required notices
Reconfirm active landlord coverage and all occupancy work
Set actual lease start and move-in dates
event: After approved applicant; complete before possession

title: Complete move-in inspection and activate the tenant calendar
checklist: Complete signed condition report, dated photos and key/access log
Provide emergency instructions and acknowledgments
Schedule first exterior/pool inspection
Enter charges, reserves, deposit, monthly benefit funding and actual lease dates
Set reporting verification, quarterly credits and annual bonus dates
Retain voluntary reporting consent and verify first submission
event: At actual move-in and before handover

title: Run the monthly rental close and operating review
source: Plan: Reserve Before Income, What Self Management Requires
checklist: Reconcile rent, bills, receipts and account balances
Fund approved vacancy, repair, capital, turnover, pool and benefit allocations
Verify reporting submissions and resolve disputes
Review inspections, tickets, pool checks and upcoming 90-day costs
Log owner hours and escalate to management review when repeated months exceed five hours or service slips
Record the next monthly occurrence
event: Monthly after tenancy begins; use actual rent and accounting calendar

title: Review quarterly tenant credits and owner distributions
source: Plan: Fair Partnership, Reserve Before Income
checklist: Apply written eligibility rules consistently and post earned prospective credits
Preserve tenant benefits independently of owner distributions
Check reserve floor, next 90-day costs and all distribution stop conditions
Owners approve any eligible distribution
Save reconciliation and schedule next quarterly review
event: Each completed qualifying lease quarter; owner distribution review at calendar quarter end

title: Review self-management after the six-month retention trial
checklist: Review service quality, owner hours, emergency handling, fees and record quality
Confirm six months of avoided-fee retention and reserve adequacy
Decide whether to continue self-management or obtain updated manager proposals
Record decision before releasing retained cash
event: Six months after self-managed tenancy starts; not applicable if professionally managed

title: Review annual tenant benefits, renewal and the hold decision
source: Plan: Fair Partnership, Tax Timing for a Later Sale
checklist: Schedule renewal notice/decision dates using reviewed lease and legal requirements
Check adviser-defined sale eligibility timing before a long renewal
Evaluate late payments, vacancy, turnover, repairs, communication and program costs
Determine earned annual capital and deposit-growth benefits under written terms
Refresh insurance, service quotes, reserve targets and hold-versus-sell decision
event: Annual review anchored to actual lease; renewal/notice work must precede contractual deadlines

title: Review fallback demand and decide whether to proceed or pause
checklist: Allow at least seven days after the actual fallback price change
Recheck listing, process, terms and competition
Maintain screening standards
Require both owners to reopen sell-versus-hold before considering rent below $2,995
Record the decision and revised schedule
event: Actual fallback date + at least 7 days; no date if price never changes
